description.value: The Griffin Pub & Liquor Store has been a Comox Valley institution since 1984, nestled next to the airbase on Kilmorley Road. The pub pours from 16 taps including local BC craft beers and house wines from Chabberton Estate, alongside a seasonal kitchen menu built around Comox Valley produce. An attached liquor store lets cyclists grab supplies to go, making this a combined eat-drink-and-stock-up stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at griffinpub.ca confirms an active pub and attached liquor store at 1185 Kilmorley Road, Comox BC, operating since 1984. The OSM phone (+1-250-339-9797) differs from the website contact number (250-339-4466), flagged as a discrepancy. No explicit evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities was found in the website text; the liquor store page confirms take-away alcohol purchases ('grab your six pack to go').
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-250-339-9797 but website contact shows 250-339-4466; OSM value may be outdated.
OSM record name is 'Griffin Liquor Store' but the business operates as 'Griffin Pub & Liquor Store' — the pub component is the primary identity on the website.
OSM has no address; address derived solely from website content.
Liquor store page notes 'WE HAVE MOVED! BACK HOME!' suggesting a prior relocation; current address appears stable at 1185 Kilmorley Rd.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a functioning pub and liquor store with food service, making it a plausible cyclist stop, but no bike-specific amenities (rack, washroom access, water refill) are confirmed. The missing required criteria mean it cannot be included without further on-the-ground verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: The liquor store is physically attached to and co-located with the Griffin Pub. Any future listing should clarify whether both the pub and the store are covered, or only the liquor store as tagged in OSM.
